description: Provision an Azure Storage StorageAccountsBlobService via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the storage.azure.com/v1api20230101 StorageAccountsBlobService spec.

automaticSnapshotPolicyEnabled.description: AutomaticSnapshotPolicyEnabled: Deprecated in favor of isVersioningEnabled property.

changeFeed.description: ChangeFeed: The blob service properties for change feed events.

enabled.description: Enabled: Indicates whether change feed event logging is enabled for the Blob service.

retentionInDays.description:
RetentionInDays: Indicates the duration of changeFeed retention in days. Minimum value is 1 day and maximum value is
146000 days (400 years). A null value indicates an infinite retention of the change feed.

containerDeleteRetentionPolicy.description: ContainerDeleteRetentionPolicy: The blob service properties for container soft delete.

allowPermanentDelete.description:
AllowPermanentDelete: This property when set to true allows deletion of the soft deleted blob versions and snapshots.
This property cannot be used blob restore policy. This property only applies to blob service and does not apply to
containers or file share.

days.description:
Days: Indicates the number of days that the deleted item should be retained. The minimum specified value can be 1 and
the maximum value can be 365.

enabled.description: Enabled: Indicates whether DeleteRetentionPolicy is enabled.

cors.description:
Cors: Specifies CORS rules for the Blob service. You can include up to five CorsRule elements in the request. If no
CorsRule elements are included in the request body, all CORS rules will be deleted, and CORS will be disabled for the
Blob service.

corsRules.description: CorsRules: The List of CORS rules. You can include up to five CorsRule elements in the request.

items.description: Specifies a CORS rule for the Blob service.

allowedHeaders.description:
AllowedHeaders: Required if CorsRule element is present. A list of headers allowed to be part of the cross-origin
request.

allowedMethods.description:
AllowedMethods: Required if CorsRule element is present. A list of HTTP methods that are allowed to be executed by the
origin.

allowedOrigins.description:
AllowedOrigins: Required if CorsRule element is present. A list of origin domains that will be allowed via CORS, or "*"
to allow all domains

exposedHeaders.description: ExposedHeaders: Required if CorsRule element is present. A list of response headers to expose to CORS clients.

maxAgeInSeconds.description:
MaxAgeInSeconds: Required if CorsRule element is present. The number of seconds that the client/browser should cache a
preflight response.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.
credentialFrom.title: Azure credential Secret

defaultServiceVersion.description:
DefaultServiceVersion: DefaultServiceVersion indicates the default version to use for requests to the Blob service if an
incoming request’s version is not specified. Possible values include version 2008-10-27 and all more recent versions.

deleteRetentionPolicy.description: DeleteRetentionPolicy: The blob service properties for blob soft delete.

allowPermanentDelete.description:
AllowPermanentDelete: This property when set to true allows deletion of the soft deleted blob versions and snapshots.
This property cannot be used blob restore policy. This property only applies to blob service and does not apply to
containers or file share.

days.description:
Days: Indicates the number of days that the deleted item should be retained. The minimum specified value can be 1 and
the maximum value can be 365.

enabled.description: Enabled: Indicates whether DeleteRetentionPolicy is enabled.

isVersioningEnabled.description: IsVersioningEnabled: Versioning is enabled if set to true.

lastAccessTimeTrackingPolicy.description: LastAccessTimeTrackingPolicy: The blob service property to configure last access time based tracking policy.

blobType.description:
BlobType: An array of predefined supported blob types. Only blockBlob is the supported value. This field is currently
read only

enable.description: Enable: When set to true last access time based tracking is enabled.

name.description: Name: Name of the policy. The valid value is AccessTimeTracking. This field is currently read only

trackingGranularityInDays.description:
TrackingGranularityInDays: The field specifies blob object tracking granularity in days, typically how often the blob
object should be tracked.This field is currently read only with value as 1

operatorSpec.description:
OperatorSpec: The specification for configuring operator behavior. This field is interpreted by the operator and not
passed directly to Azure

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.

labels.description: Labels is an optional set of labels to apply to the destination resource.

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes configmap or secret to write to.
The configmap or secret will be created in the same namespace as the resource.

value.description:
Value is a CEL expression. The CEL expression may return a string or a map[string]string. For more information
on CEL in ASO see https://azure.github.io/azure-service-operator/guide/expressions/

owner.description:
Owner: The owner of the resource. The owner controls where the resource goes when it is deployed. The owner also
controls the resources lifecycle. When the owner is deleted the resource will also be deleted. Owner is expected to be a
reference to a storage.azure.com/StorageAccount resource

name.description: This is the name of the Kubernetes resource to reference.

restorePolicy.description: RestorePolicy: The blob service properties for blob restore policy.

days.description: Days: how long this blob can be restored. It should be great than zero and less than DeleteRetentionPolicy.days.

enabled.description: Enabled: Blob restore is enabled if set to true.
